description: XID_Start/XID_Continue from unicode-ident (in Cargo.lock, becomes direct), Elixir's lowercase-or-underscore start rule, trailing ? and !, non-ASCII alias rejected with Elixir's message. source_word_token (quoted_surface.rs is_local_function_name) and keyword_or_ident change in the same step. Removes byte predicates ident_start/ident_cont. Signal: oracle fixtures for a variable, function name, atom, keyword key on three paths; diagnostic fixture for a non-ASCII alias.
title: The lexer reads identifiers and atoms by Unicode class
